title: Investigation Clears Sumiken Building Purchase
summary:
*   **Sumiken Inquiry Update:** A special counsel presented findings from an investigation into the purchase of the Sumiken Building, reporting that no official misconduct was found.
*   **New Board & Commission Members:** The city appointed numerous citizens to various boards and commissions, covering areas such as the airport, arts, economic development, and urban transportation.
*   **Focused Meeting:** Beyond the appointments, the Sumiken investigation was the only other item discussed during this special session, highlighting its significance.

Mayor Cooke called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence

STATUS REPORT ON SUMIKEN INQUIRY
-
Bob Smith, special counsel investigating the purchase of the Sumiken Building, reported
his findings to Council. He summarized his statements by saying no official misconduct has
been found.
Council asked questions and had a discussion.
No other items on the agenda were discussed.
